must_recall: helping the newer employees with my knowledge

turns.content: I've been wanting to spend more time helping the newer folks at work.
Is that about the formal side of mentoring, or just helping them get up to speed with what you know?

More the second. Just helping the newer employees with my knowledge — there's no formal program for it. I see them struggle with things I figured out years ago, and I want to actually take the time to teach. That impact matters to me more than another title bump.
What kind of professional identity am I building?
